preHint: Press {demo} to begin the scripted feed.
preHintLive: Press {demo} for a scripted feed, or {live} for one narrated by the agents.
liveHint: Waiting for the first insight from the match.
feedTip: Click a card to preview it on screen, or drag it to the spot you want. J / K moves between cards.
empty: Cards appear here as the matches unfold.
emptyFilter: No cards for this game yet.
emptyFocus: No cards for this focus yet.
headline: Headline
arrowsMove: Drag it anywhere on screen, or use the arrow keys. Hold Shift for bigger steps.
arrowsW: Use left and right arrow keys.
arrowsH: Use up and down arrow keys.
selectHint: Click or drag a card from the feed onto the screen.
editHint: Drag to place it · click its text to edit · × to remove
sendMsg: Going live in 5 seconds. Press Escape to cancel.
cancelMsg: Cancelled. The card is back on screen for editing.
shortcuts: J / K move · Enter go live · Esc cancel or pull
overlayEmpty: Nothing on air. Viewers see only the match picture.
matchStarted: Match started. The first cards arrive within a minute.
matchJoined: A match is already live, so you've joined it.
matchesBusy: Two matches are already running. Try again in {min} min.
matchesDaily: Today's match limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
startFailed: Couldn't start a match. Try again.
overlayNote: This tab shows only what is on air for the chosen transmission, exactly as viewers get it. Nothing here can be edited: you choose and send cards from the control room in the other tab.
helpIntro: Calacat Narrator turns match data into short on-screen cards. This page is the control room: you pick a card, check it in preview and send it to air.
helpDemo: {demo} plays a scripted match in this browser. It starts instantly, costs nothing and runs the same every time, so it is the quickest way to try the console.
helpLive: {live} asks the server to simulate a new match. AI agents write each card and a Reviewer checks it, so the first cards take up to a minute. Up to two matches run at a time.
helpStep1: Click a card in the insight feed, or drag it onto the monitor.
helpStep2: Move, resize or edit it. It is only a preview until you send it.
helpStep3: Press {golive}. You have 5 seconds to cancel with Esc.
helpStep4: {overlay} opens what viewers see for the chosen transmission in a new tab.
